windowsPowerShellAdaptation.processInterruption: PowerShell Get-NetTCPConnection + Stop-Process; Ctrl+C preferred for foreground services
windowsPowerShellAdaptation.sideEffectGate: git push, deploy, GitHub Release, npm publish, npm unpublish require explicit confirmation
windowsPowerShellAdaptation.skillDiscovery: Codex CLI discovers short skills as jingyuan:<skill> from plugins/cache/local/jingyuan/local after [plugins."jingyuan@local"] is enabled; installer writes both the source copy and cache copy

validation.installWhatIf: passed: installs only complete plugin and removes obsolete flat skill copies
validation.bomCheck: passed: all plugin SKILL.md files start with raw --- bytes
validation.marketplaceEncoding: passed: marketplace.json is UTF-8 JSON without BOM
validation.configEnablement: passed: installer enables jingyuan@local in Codex config
validation.cacheInstall: passed: installer syncs plugins/cache/local/jingyuan/local for Codex plugin loading

notes: The previous skills-only installer was replaced with a complete-plugin installer.
The local installer defaults to the Codex home directory rather than the user home directory.
The installer keeps the complete plugin under plugins/jingyuan, syncs plugins/cache/local/jingyuan/local, and removes obsolete flat skill discovery entries to avoid duplicate loading.
The installer writes the local marketplace and Codex config with UTF-8 without BOM where applicable.
Shared assets and references are kept under plugins/jingyuan and are installed with the plugin.
Unix command examples were removed from primary skill flows; historical Claude references remain under references/claude-original.
